title: Animal consciousness is a collateral product, like a locomotive's steam whistle

statements.text: The consciousness of animals is related to the mechanism of their bodies only as a collateral product of its working, with no more power to change that working than the steam whistle has over a locomotive's machinery. Their volition, if they have any, signals physical changes and does not cause them, so the old question of how volition could move matter does not arise for them.

sources.quote: and to be as completely without any power of modifying that working as the steam-whistle which accompanies the work of a locomotive engine is without influence upon its machinery
Their volitions do not enter into the chain of causation of their actions at all.
